the Center script in: through the door and up to the nurse; no map of the Center
full HP and PP (pokeguy uses an Oran Berry in the gym instead, 1:14:38; healing is the safe side)
HM03 Surf in place of Water Gun, as pokeguy (1:14:55 to 1:15:13: Surf, Water Pulse, Bite, Mega Kick after it), unless the lead knows it; an HM, so not a one-shot TM

out of the Center (its ground floor coded), west along row 32 to the gym's door (9, 32), and in the gym (no running) from the mat (7, 21) east along row 21 to the east wall: below Juggler Kayden's south line (12, 17..20) and Nate's (2, 17..20)
up column 14 from (14, 21) to (14, 17), a tile below Kayden's east line (13..14, 16): a planned route here goes up column 12 or 13 and meets his south line

onto (14, 16), the second tile of Kayden's east line: he faces south or east (MOVEMENT_TYPE_FACE_DOWN_AND_RIGHT), and once he faces east he walks to (13, 16). up column 14 from (14, 16) to (14, 12), a tile below Juggler Kirk's line (12..14, 11)
onto (14, 11), the end of Kirk's line (sight 3, facing east): he walks east to (13, 11) (pokeguy 1:15:14)
Juggler Kirk (TRAINER_JUGGLER_KIRK): Drowzee, Drowzee, Kadabra, Drowzee, all Lv31 (pokeguy: one Surf each, 1:15:14 to 1:16:17)
up column 14 from (14, 11) to the wall at (14, 2): past Tamer Edgar's east line (14, 4) when he looks east (he looks every way), on a leg the wall stops
west along row 2 to the wall at (0, 2), the gym's top edge (pokeguy's invisible-wall corridor, 1:16:18): past Edgar's north line (13, 2..3) when he looks north, on a leg the wall stops

east along row 2 to (9, 2), down column 9 to the wall at (9, 10), west along row 10 to (2, 10), below Rocker Shawn (2, 9), who looks west at (1, 9) only, down to (2, 12) and into the middle box along row 12 to (6, 12) and (6, 13): out of Tamer Phil's lines round (4, 6), which a planned route crosses
turn to Koga (7, 13): pokeguy approaches him from the west (1:16:33)

checkpoint: Starts where 11.03's Fly lands, below Fuchsia's Center facing south, and goes in to the nurse (pokeguy bikes straight into the gym from there, 1:14:38; the Center heal is ours).

PokeGuy's way (1:14:38 to 1:16:33): into the gym, Surf taught over Water Gun, Juggler Kirk fought (forced), round the top edge, Koga from the west. He fights nobody else; this row also fights Juggler Kayden (Hypno Lv38), whose east line every way north crosses with no wall to end a leg on (a deviation, for the user).

The gym (FuchsiaCity_Gym map.json), 15 x 23, no running, its invisible walls in the map: Koga (7, 13) in the middle box, entered only from row 12 on the west. Its trainers and lines: Kayden (12, 16) south and east 4, Shawn (2, 9) west 1, Kirk (11, 11) east 3, Edgar (13, 4) every way 2, Phil (4, 6) every way 2, Nate (2, 16) south 4. Every way north crosses Kirk's line and one of Kayden's and Edgar's; the legs across a looker's line end on walls.

Ends west of Koga and saves there: his own pre-battle checkpoint (battle-checkpoint-retry), 12.02. Koga is a D7 fight: pokeguy entered at 34/122 HP and the PokemonSimulation benchmark wins 70.1% from that; this row enters at full HP and PP after the Center (the full-heal comparison is still pending there).
